author_name: กระบี่ ลันตา

text: The doctor gave good advice, and the children's toys in the clinic were very helpful for parents.

We live in the city, but many times we've driven across districts to see a doctor. We checked on Google Maps and the doctor opens at 7 am. Today, I drove all the way there crying because my child had a high fever. We arrived at 6 am and saw the doctor slightly opening the door. He was so kind and immediately treated my child. He's always like this. After we got home and gave my child one dose of medicine, my child's condition improved. The diagnosis was correct too. Thank you from the bottom of my heart, dear mother.

author_name: อนงค์รัตน์ เพ็งรักษ์
